parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL ID, name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL1126800. Source the document identifier from the docs table and join to compound records and molecule dictionary to retrieve compound attributes. Join to compound structures to obtain canonical SMILES. Filter by the document ChEMBL ID equal to CHEMBL1126800. Sort the results by the compound ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
